categories.name: limit-conn
categories.description: A request was rejected by a limit_conn zone.

categories.name: limit-conn-dry-run
categories.description: A request would have been rejected by a limit_conn zone in dry-run mode.

categories.name: limit-req
categories.description: A request was rejected by a limit_req zone.

categories.name: limit-req-dry-run
categories.description: A request would have been rejected by a limit_req zone in dry-run mode.
categories.pattern: ^limiting requests, dry run, excess: [0-9.]+ by zone "([^"]+)"

categories.name: limit-req-delay
categories.description: A request was delayed by a limit_req zone.

categories.name: upstream-timeout
categories.description: The upstream did not answer in time.

categories.name: upstream-refused
categories.pattern: ^connect\(\) failed \(111: Connection refused\) while connecting to upstream

categories.name: upstream-closed
categories.description: The upstream closed the connection before answering.

categories.name: upstream-reset
categories.pattern: ^recv\(\) failed \(104: Connection reset by peer\) while reading (?:response header )?from upstream

categories.name: body-too-large
categories.description: A request body was larger than client_max_body_size.
categories.pattern: ^client intended to send too large body

categories.name: buffered-response-to-disk
categories.description: An upstream response was too large for its buffers and went to a temporary file.
categories.pattern: ^an upstream response is buffered to a temporary file

categories.name: buffered-request-to-disk
categories.description: A request body was too large for its buffer and went to a temporary file.
categories.pattern: ^a client request body is buffered to a temporary file

categories.name: tls-handshake
categories.description: A TLS handshake with a client failed.

categories.name: file-not-found
categories.description: A file nginx was asked to serve does not exist.
categories.pattern: ^open\(\) ".*" failed \((?:2: No such file or directory|20: Not a directory)\)

categories.name: worker-crash
categories.description: A worker process exited on a signal.
